name: FishMackerel
concept: A mackerel for the fish counter: its own model for the medium catch; the small and large catch scale the same Meshy generation.
prompt: A single Atlantic mackerel fish, whole, swimming pose seen from the side, body straight and torpedo shaped, slender, tail fin spread, two dorsal fins and small finlets, dark blue-green back with wavy black tiger stripes, silver white belly, round dark eye. Realistic game prop, no base, no stand, no water, no text, no logos.
texture_prompt: Atlantic mackerel: iridescent blue-green back with dark wavy bars, silvery white belly, glossy wet skin.
